assets.prompt: Transform the referenced 4 by 4 sprite atlas into a VERY CUTE monochrome desktop ornament collection, preserving exactly the same sixteen-cell layout and subject assignments. Transparent PNG alpha background, square image. Four equal rows and four equal columns; each object fully separate and centered in its own invisible cell with clear margin, no grid or letters. Art direction: clean charming 2D little toy stickers, rounded organic silhouettes, bold smooth charcoal outlines, simple broad off-white/light-gray/medium-gray fills, minimal soft gray shading, NO gritty realistic textures, NO pixel-art noise. Black white gray only. The four rocky blocks are friendly pebble creatures with tiny dot eyes and a little smiling mouth, visible even at 45px. Row 1: intact quartz crystal pebble creature; coal pebble creature; metal-vein pebble creature; gemstone pebble creature. Row 2: matching gently cracked/chipped variants of those four, same faces and placements, clearly damaged rock but charming and undistressed. Row 3: empty excavated rock socket; little loose pebbles; small toy pickaxe; tiny cute ore cart. Row 4: rounded crystal cluster; faceted diamond; coin stack; little smiling hanging lantern. The decorative objects should feel like friendly desk companions rather than game inventory icons. Keep strong silhouettes and very few details. No colored pixels, no text or numbers, no UI buttons, no borders or checkerboard, no scene or floor, no cast shadows beyond objects.

Transform the referenced 4 by 4 plant sprite atlas into a VERY CUTE monochrome desktop ornament collection, preserving exactly the sixteen-cell subject layout. Transparent PNG alpha background, square image, four equal rows and four equal columns, each object fully inside its own invisible cell with padding. Art direction: clean charming 2D little toy stickers, soft rounded plant silhouettes, bold smooth charcoal outlines, broad off-white/light-gray/medium-gray fills, minimal soft gray shading, NO gritty realism or pixel noise. Black white gray only. Every plant sits in the same squat rounded ceramic pot with tiny dot eyes and a small smiling mouth on the front: expressive but subtle. Pot bases aligned to 85 percent down the cell; consistent pot size. Row1: empty soil pot; seeded mound pot; two-leaf sprout pot; leafy young plant pot. Row2: mature clover; dandelion puff; daisies; pansies. Row3: grass tuft; lavender; mint herb; sunflower. Row4: tulip; rose; fern; lily. Mature flowers have sweet, simple rounded petals, no excessive detail. Empty pot looks content, sprout and grown pots look quietly cheerful. This is a set of tiny adorable botanical desk companions, not a game screen. No colors, no text, no numbers, no UI frames, no grid, no checkerboard, no floor or background scene, no external cast shadows.

Create one square transparent PNG production sprite atlas for a cute monochrome desktop ornament app. Exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, sixteen isolated objects, centered inside separate equal invisible cells with generous transparent padding. Style: adorable clean 2D toy stickers, soft round silhouettes, bold smooth charcoal outlines, tiny dot eyes and subtle smiles where appropriate, simple large off-white/light-gray/medium-gray areas, minimal gray shading. Strictly black/white/gray. NOT gritty, NOT pixel art, NOT realistic. Crisp and readable at 24 to 64px. Row1 left-to-right: unlit sleepy little lightbulb with gray glass and a face; SAME little bulb happily lit with off-white glass (NO colored glow); cute squat battery with a face; tiny friendly electric plug. Row2: cute closed keepsake box with a face; matching open box with a simple upward arrow above its opening (export); matching open box with a simple downward arrow toward its opening (import); small flower-shaped settings cog with a dark center. Row3: small magnifying glass; little coin pouch; little ladder; toy pickaxe with a small upward arrow (upgrade). Row4: simple seed packet with leaf picture and no writing; little watering can; empty smiling flowerpot with a small plus sign beside it; small folded ribbon with two short horizontal bars (collapse). Equal spacing and size, objects wholly inside their cells, nothing touches neighbor cells. No captions, text, letters, digits, UI button frames, grid lines, checkerboard, scene background, or external cast shadows. Only the simple arrow/plus/bar graphic symbols described above are permitted.
